tools.name: publish_html
tools.description: Publish an HTML page on HTMLpad and get a public link to share. Returns the link, a private edit link and an edit token. Free pads stay online for 90 days. Pages may not contain password or payment card fields.

tools.name: update_pad
tools.description: Replace the HTML of a pad you published, using the edit token returned by publish_html. Saving also resets its 90 days.

tools.name: get_pad
tools.description: Get the HTML of a public pad on HTMLpad.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "publish_html" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: publish_html, get_pad · Private data: publish_html, update_pad · Public sink: publish_html.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: publish_html, get_pad · Private data: publish_html, update_pad · Public sink: publish_html

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
